candidates.name: Prestige Distribution, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Installer page claims 5,000+ installations of commercial bathroom stall partitions, certified installer for Privada, Thrislington and Holtman, and lists brands installed (ASI, Bobrick, Hadrian, Scranton). Services include field measurement and installation. A search result also cited a Chicago RSM office job (Privada partitions furnished and installed), but I did not open that project page.
red_flags: Sells and distributes partitions itself, including ASI, Bobrick, Bradley and Scranton, which Next Partitions also resells: high buy-around risk
Installs through a nationwide contractor network as well as its own team, so who does the work isn't clear
candidates.reason: A Northbrook distributor that clearly furnishes and installs commercial toilet partitions in Chicagoland. It is a direct competitor in partition sales, so it is a strong installer but a serious buy-around risk.

license.name: Prestige Distribution, Inc.
license.registry: City of Chicago Department of Buildings, General Contractors (Active and Inactive) list
license.note: None of the 11,683 active or inactive Chicago general contractor records contains 'Prestige Distribution', and no record for this firm has a Northbrook address. The 'Prestige' records that do appear are unrelated firms (Prestige Construction LLC in La Grange, Prestige Contracting Services in Wilmette and others). The firm may be a distributor that hands installation to subcontractors, or it may not work inside Chicago city limits; confirm before listing. There is no state license in Illinois.

candidates.name: ISI - Installation Specialists, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Its capabilities page lists "Restrooms and Locker Rooms (benches, cabinetry, lockers, partitions)" under custom woodworking installation. It never says "toilet partitions" and shows no restroom stall photos.
red_flags: Mainly a commercial furniture installer; restroom partitions are only one line in its capabilities list
Contact page URL taken from the site's menu link, not opened
candidates.reason: A large, long-running commercial installer in Chicagoland with restroom partitions in its capabilities. Toilet partition work isn't shown, so it is a possible candidate with no buy-around risk.

license.name: ISI - Installation Specialists, Inc.
license.registry: City of Chicago Department of Buildings, General Contractors (Active and Inactive) list
license.note: Listed as INSTALLATION SPECIALISTS INC, base city Itasca, IL. License expiration 04/15/2027, 'License Inactive?' = No. Read from the JSON feed behind the list page (https://webapps1.chicago.gov/licensedcontractors/allcontractors/paginated/general, all 11,683 records downloaded and searched by name) on 2026-11-19. Illinois has no state general contractor license, so the Chicago DOB license is the only record that applies, and only for work inside Chicago city limits.

candidates.name: Partition Pros
candidates.partition_evidence: The homepage says "We offer a full line of toilet partitions" and the About section mentions installing bathroom partitions. The main business is gym equipment, operable partitions and bleachers.
red_flags: Main focus is operable gym partitions, bleachers and backstops, not restroom stalls
Offers its own line of toilet partitions (buy-around risk)
Base city not shown on its own site (Bartlett comes from the candidate list and a MapQuest search result); no project photos of restroom stalls seen
Contact page lists personal cell numbers for sales staff; only the office number is used here
candidates.reason: Its own site says it supplies and installs toilet partitions for institutional and commercial facilities in the west suburbs. The partition work is secondary to gym equipment and there are no restroom project photos, so confirm during vetting.

license.name: Partition Pros
license.registry: City of Chicago Department of Buildings, General Contractors (Active and Inactive) list
license.note: No Chicago general contractor record (active or inactive) contains 'Partition', and none of the Bartlett-address records matches this firm. If it takes jobs inside Chicago city limits that need a permit, it would need a DOB general contractor license (Class A to E), or would have to work under a licensed general contractor. Confirm with the firm and Chicago DOB. There is no state license in Illinois.

candidates.name: Commercial Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Its own site is an online store selling toilet partitions (stock baked enamel and solid plastic) and Bradley washroom accessories, with no installation text. Search snippets of its Blue Book listing (thebluebook.com/iProView/805136, which returned 403 so I couldn't read it) say it has provided installation of toilet compartments, shower compartments and lockers for 30+ years in Chicagoland and Northwest Indiana.
red_flags: Sells partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Installation claim seen only in search snippets of a directory listing, not on its own site
Snippets mention 1-4 employees and a 2006 establishment date that conflicts with the 30+ years claim
candidates.reason: A Rolling Meadows partition and washroom accessories dealer that may also install. Its own site doesn't show installation, so it stays possible until confirmed.

license.name: Commercial Specialties, Inc.
license.registry: City of Chicago Department of Buildings, General Contractors (Active and Inactive) list
license.note: No Chicago general contractor record (active or inactive) contains 'Commercial Specialt', and none of the Rolling Meadows-address records matches this firm. It may work as a subcontractor under a licensed general contractor's permit; confirm with the firm and Chicago DOB. There is no state license in Illinois.

candidates.name: Consumers Supply Company
candidates.partition_evidence: Sells Hadrian toilet partitions in its plumbing supply catalogue. No installation service shown.
red_flags: Plumbing supply house that sells partitions (buy-around risk)
No installation evidence
candidates.reason: A Chicago plumbing and bath supplier that sells Hadrian partitions but shows no installation work, so it isn't an installer.

candidates.name: One Point Partitions
candidates.partition_evidence: From search results only (its site returned 403): an online partition seller with 5-7 day delivery and do-it-yourself install tutorials. Its installation page says hiring professionals "isn't necessary". Illinois locations named in snippets look like delivery terminals.
red_flags: Online partition seller and direct competitor
Do-it-yourself installation model, no install crews shown
Site blocked automated access; nothing read first-hand
candidates.reason: A national online seller of partitions with do-it-yourself installation. It isn't an installer and is a competitor.

candidates.name: LaForce (Chicago offices)
candidates.partition_evidence: The Building Specialties page lists 'Toilet Partitions', 'Multiple Material Types' and 'Partition Hardware for all Manufacturers' as products LaForce provides. Its Pre-Install & Install page covers only doors, frames and door hardware, and no page shows toilet partition installation.
red_flags: Supplies toilet partitions itself, as a commercial door, hardware and Division 10 distributor (direct competitor and buy-around risk)
No evidence that it installs partitions; its install service is doors, frames and hardware only
Large multi-state distributor with headquarters in Green Bay, WI, not a local installer
candidates.reason: LaForce is a commercial Division 10 and door-hardware distributor that sells toilet partitions. Its installation service covers doors and hardware only, so it is a competing supplier rather than an installer. Chicago-area offices are in Vernon Hills ((847) 634-2828) and Willowbrook ((630) 325-1950); the general line is 1-800-236-8858 and no company email is published.

candidates.name: D&B Installers Inc.
candidates.review_source: BBB (A+ letter grade, not accredited; no review count shown)
red_flags: No website found.
BBB categories are Lockers, Storage Units and Wholesale Industrial Products, with nothing about toilet partitions.
Bourbonnais is about 50 miles from the area center, and there's no statement that it serves Chicago.
The BBB rating is a letter grade (A+), not a star rating; the 0 is a placeholder.
candidates.partition_evidence: Appears only in BBB 'Partition' category search results; its own categories are lockers and storage units.
candidates.reason: Nothing shows toilet partition installation: there's no website, and BBB lists only lockers, storage and wholesale industrial products. It may be a locker installer worth a phone check, but as researched it doesn't qualify.
